list.comment:
Refactor: Fix memory leaks and update project documentation
This commit addresses critical memory leaks related to `Activity` references and improves project documentation. It also includes several IDE configuration updates.
- **`AdMobManager.kt`**: - Fixed a major memory leak in `initSplashScreen` where a `CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default)` was collecting a `SharedFlow` indefinitely while holding a reference to the `Activity`. - Refactored the logic to use the `Activity`'s `lifecycleScope` and `first()` to ensure the coroutine completes and the reference is released. - Updated `EventBus` to use a `MutableSharedFlow` with `replay = 1` for more reliable event delivery during initialization.
- **`MainActivity.kt`**: - Added an `onDestroy` override to nullify the `AdMobManager.interstitialListener`. This prevents the Singleton `AdMobManager` from holding a strong reference to a destroyed `MainActivity`.
- **Documentation**: - Renamed `app/doc/init.md` to `doc/memory_leak.md` and significantly expanded it. - Added a detailed report on potential and fixed memory leaks, covering `SharedFlow` collectors, Singleton listeners, and `Handler.postDelayed` usage. - Included a summary of the project's architectural health and tech stack (Jetpack Compose, GetX, Hilt).
- **IDE Configuration (`.idea/`)**: - Added `markdown.xml` to configure the markdown preview provider. - Updated `deviceStreaming.xml` with an extensive list of persistent device selection data for various Samsung, Google, and Motorola devices. - Removed the redundant `modules.xml`. - Updated `workspace.xml` with recent changes, task history, and component state.

task.summary: Default task

Update SDK and IDE configuration files
This commit updates the SDK versions and various IDE configuration files.
- Incremented `compileSdk` from 35 to 36 and `targetSdk` from 35 to 36 in `app/build.gradle`. - Updated `versionCode` to 20250929 and `versionName` to "2025.09.29" in `app/build.gradle`. - Changed `gradleJvm` from `openjdk-20` to `#GRADLE_LOCAL_JAVA_HOME` in `.idea/gradle.xml`. - Updated JDK version from 20 to 21 in `.idea/misc.xml` and from 20 to 21 in `.idea/compiler.xml`. - Modified `.idea/caches/deviceStreaming.xml` to update the list of persistent device selection data. - Added `.idea/workspace.xml` and `.claude/settings.local.json`. - Removed `.idea/.gitignore`, `.idea/appInsightsSettings.xml`, `.idea/inspectionProfiles/Project_Default.xml`, and `.idea/icon.png`. - Updated `.idea/vcs.xml` to include a new mapping for the project directory.

Suppress unsupported compile SDK warning
This commit changes the `gradle.properties` file. - The `android.defaults.buildfeatures.buildconfig=true` line is removed. - A new line, `android.suppressUnsupportedCompileSdk=36`, is added. This suppresses warnings when using a compile SDK version that is not yet fully supported by the Android Gradle Plugin.

Enable Proguard and update related configurations
This commit enables Proguard for release builds and updates various related configurations.
- In `app/build.gradle`: - `minifyEnabled` and `shrinkResources` are set to `true` for release builds. - `resourceConfigurations` is added to keep only specified major languages, reducing APK size. - Several exclusion rules are added to `packagingOptions.resources` to further reduce APK size. - `jniLibs.useLegacyPackaging` is set to `false`. - In `app/proguard-rules.pro`: - Rules are added to keep classes related to XML parsing (org.kxml2.io, javax.xml). - Keep rules are added for Jetpack Compose, AdMob, Kotlin Coroutines, Retrofit & OkHttp, data models, Hilt, Room, and Coil. - The `.idea/caches/deviceStreaming.xml` file is updated with new device definitions. - The `.idea/workspace.xml` file is updated, including changes to the selected execution target. - The `.claude/settings.local.json` file is updated to allow a new Bash command.

Update Rome library and ProGuard rules
This commit updates the Rome library to version 2.1.0 and refactors the ProGuard rules for improved XML parsing and code shrinking.
- In `app/build.gradle`: - Updated `com.rometools:rome` from `"$rome"` to `2.1.0`. - Removed `es` (Spanish) and `ru` (Russian) from `resourceConfigurations` to reduce APK size. - In `app/proguard-rules.pro`: - Refined XML Parser fixes for comprehensive handling of `org.xmlpull.v1`, `org.kxml2.io`, `javax.xml`, and `org.xml.sax`. - Added rules to address potential R8 XML parsing issues, including warnings for various XML-related packages and specific class relationship notes. - Updated Rome keep rules to be more specific, allowing shrinking and obfuscation for `com.rometools.rome.feed`, `com.rometools.rome.io`, and `com.rometools.modules` packages. - Introduced minimal keep rules for `org.xmlpull.v1.XmlPullParser` and `org.xmlpull.v1.XmlSerializer` interfaces. - Added aggressive shrinking rules, including `allowaccessmodification`, `dontpreverify`, and `repackageclasses ''`. - Included rules to remove logging (`android.util.Log`) and debug code (`kotlin.jvm.internal.Intrinsics.checkParameterIsNotNull`) in release builds.

Refactor code to address deprecations and update APIs
This commit updates several parts of the codebase to address deprecated APIs and adopt newer practices.
- **`FeverRssSv.kt` and `RssHelper.kt`**: Updated `Html.fromHtml` calls to use the version with `Html.FROM_HTML_MODE_LEGACY` for Android N and above, while retaining the deprecated version for older OS versions with `@Suppress("DEPRECATION")`. - **`SplashActivity.kt`**: - Replaced deprecated `overridePendingTransition` with `ActivityOptions.makeCustomAnimation` for activity transitions on Android 14 (API 34) and above. - Retained `overridePendingTransition` with `@Suppress("DEPRECATION")` for older OS versions. - **`Activity.kt` (UI extensions)**: - Replaced deprecated `systemUiVisibility` and related flags with `WindowInsetsControllerCompat` for managing status bar, navigation bar, and fullscreen modes on Android R (API 30) and above. - Retained the deprecated methods with `@Suppress("DEPRECATION")` for older OS versions. This affects `setChangeStatusBarTintToDark`, `showStatusBar`, `hideStatusBar`, `toggleFullscreen`, `hideNavigationBar`, `showNavigationBar`, `hideDefaultControls`, and `showDefaultControls`. - **`AdMobManager.kt`**: Suppressed deprecation warning for `connectivityManager.activeNetworkInfo` as it's used as a fallback for older OS versions. - **`LanguagesPref.kt`**: - Updated `Locale` creation to use `Locale.Builder()` for better clarity and future-proofing. - Removed redundant calls to `resources.updateConfiguration()` as `createConfigurationContext()` is sufficient.

Refactor and enhance stability
This commit introduces several refactorings and stability improvements:
- In `SplashActivity.kt`, `lifecycleScope.launch` with a `delay` is now used for finishing the activity after the animation, replacing `window.decorView.postDelayed`. - In `CrashHandler.kt`: - A `WeakReference` to the `Context` is now used to prevent potential memory leaks. - Toast display for uncaught exceptions is now wrapped in a `try-catch` block and only shown if the context is still available. - In `WebView.kt`, a `DisposableEffect` is added to properly dispose of the `WebView` when the composable is disposed. This includes stopping loading, clearing history and cache, loading "about:blank", pausing, removing all views, and destroying the WebView to prevent memory leaks. Error logging is added for the disposal process. - Removed trailing newlines in `RApp.kt` and `MainActivity.kt`.

Refactor and update dependencies
This commit includes several refactoring changes and dependency updates.
- In `TextComposer.kt`, `spanStack.reversed()` is replaced with `spanStack.asReversed()`. - In `HomeEntry.kt`, `intent?.extras?.get(ExtraName.ARTICLE_ID)?.toString()` is replaced with `intent?.extras?.getString(ExtraName.ARTICLE_ID)`. - In `Activity.kt`, the logic for getting Facebook `versionCode` is updated to use `longVersionCode` for Android P and above. - In `AccountDetailsPage.kt`, `ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument()` is updated to `ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/xml")`. - In `RApp.kt`, the class now implements `ImageLoaderFactory` and provides a custom `ImageLoader`. - In `MainActivity.kt`, the explicit `LocalImageLoader` provider is removed as `RApp` now provides it. - In `TextFieldDlg.kt`, `@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER")` is added to the `properties` parameter. - In `ExtDate.kt`, a null check is added for `ConfigurationCompat.getLocales(context.resources.configuration)[0]` and defaults to `Locale.getDefault()` if null. - In `BaseAsyncImage.kt`, `rememberImagePainter` is replaced with `rememberAsyncImagePainter` and its parameters are updated accordingly.

Add Advertising ID permission and backup rules
This commit introduces the following changes: - Adds the `com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID` permission to `AndroidManifest.xml` for advertising and analytics purposes. - Includes new XML files `backup_rules.xml` and `data_extraction_rules.xml` to define backup and data extraction behavior. - Updates `AndroidManifest.xml` to reference these new rules files. - Adds metadata for AdMob App ID, delayed app measurement initialization, and disables automatic screen reporting for Google Analytics.

Update app theme to Material Design 3 and enhance UI elements
This commit migrates the app's theme to Material Design 3, introducing updated color schemes, typography, and shapes. It also enhances various UI components and adds new animations.
Key changes: - **Material Design 3 Theme:** - Updated `themes.xml` for both light and dark modes to use `Theme.Material3` parents. - Defined new Material 3 color attributes (primary, secondary, tertiary, error, surface, background, outline, etc.) in `colors.xml` for both light and dark themes. - Updated `windowBackground` and `ic_launcher_background` colors. - **Typography:** - Refined `SystemTypography` in `Type.kt` with updated font weights and letter spacing for Material 3 guidelines. - Added new custom text styles for reader-specific content: `ReaderTitleStyle`, `ReaderSubtitleStyle`, `ReaderBodyStyle`, `ReaderCaptionStyle`, and `ReaderOverlineStyle`. - **Shapes:** - Updated `Shapes.kt` with Material 3 shape definitions. - Added various custom `RoundedCornerShape` variations for modern UI elements, including asymmetric and directional shapes (e.g., `ShapeTop16`, `ShapeBottom16`, `ShapeStart16`). - Defined specific shapes for UI components like `CardShape`, `ButtonShape`, `InputShape`, `ChipShape`, `BottomSheetShape`, and `DialogShape`. - **Animations:** - Added new animation resource files: - `slide_in_right.xml`, `slide_out_left.xml` (for window transitions) - `slide_up.xml`, `slide_down.xml` - `fade_in.xml`, `fade_out.xml` - Defined `WindowAnimationTransition` style in `themes.xml` using the new slide animations. - **UI Component Enhancements:** - `BaseAsyncImage.kt`: - Changed default `contentScale` to `ContentScale.Crop`. - Added `enableClipping` and `cornerRadius` parameters, defaulting to true and `12.dp` respectively. - Applied background color from `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface` and clipping to the image. - Updated placeholder and error image tinting to use theme colors. - `BlockButton.kt`: - Updated container and content colors to use Material 3 theme colors. - Increased height to `64.dp` and corner radius to `16.dp`. - Adjusted padding. - **Splash Screen:** - Updated `startup.xml` with a modern gradient background using theme colors. - Centered the app logo (`ic_launcher_foreground`) and increased its size. - Added a modern loading indicator below the logo. - **Launcher Icon:** - Updated `ic_launcher_foreground.xml` with a new modern book icon design, including page lines, a corner fold, and a bookmark. - **Styles:** - Added new styles in `themes.xml` for `ModernCard`, `ModernButton`, `ModernButtonOutlined`, and `ModernTextInput` using Material 3 components and the new shapes.

Enhance splash screen and add loading animations
This commit refactors the splash screen UI and introduces new loading animations.
- In `SplashActivity.kt`: - The `SplashScreen` composable is updated to display the app logo, app name ("RSS Hub"), a "Loading..." text, and a `CircularProgressIndicator`. - The "Please note: this action may show ads" text is restyled and repositioned. - In `app/src/main/res/drawable/startup.xml`: - The existing modern gradient background is simplified to a gradient background. - The app logo and modern loading indicator items are removed. - A new subtle overlay item is added for depth. - New animation resource files are added: - `app/src/main/res/anim/loading_rotation.xml`: A simple rotation animation. - `app/src/main/res/anim/loading_pulse.xml`: A pulse animation combining scale and alpha changes. - New drawable resource files for loading indicators are added: - `app/src/main/res/drawable/loading_spinner.xml`: A vector drawable for a two-ring spinner. - `app/src/main/res/drawable/loading_dots.xml`: A vector drawable for three animating dots.

Update splash screen UI and background
This commit updates the `SplashActivity` UI and the background drawable used for the splash screen.
- In `SplashActivity.kt`: - The app logo image is changed from `ic_launcher_foreground` to `ic_launcher_round`. - The text color of "RSS Hub", "Loading...", and "Please note: this action may show ads" is updated to use `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface`. - The `CircularProgressIndicator` color is updated to use `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary`. - In `app/src/main/res/drawable/startup.xml`: - The gradient background is removed. - The background now uses a solid color defined by `?attr/colorSurface`. - A new file `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_round.png` is added.

Update startup screen background and icon
This commit updates the startup screen. - The background color is changed from the dynamic `?attr/colorSurface` to a static white (`#ffffff`). - The background shape is given a fixed size of 900dp width and 1900dp height. - An icon (`@drawable/ic_launcher_960`) with a size of 220sp x 220sp is added and centered on the screen.

Add "Add RSS Sources" feature
This commit introduces a new feature that allows users to browse and add RSS sources from a predefined list categorized by country.
- **Models and Data:** - Added `RssSource` and `RssSourcesData` data classes to represent RSS source information. - Created `rss_sources.json` in assets to store predefined RSS sources for English and Vietnamese. - Introduced `AddedRssSource` entity and `AddedRssSourceDao` for tracking user-added RSS sources in the database. - Updated `AndroidDatabase` to include `AddedRssSourceDao` and added `MIGRATION_5_6` for the new table. - Added a new schema `6.json` for the database. - **Repository and ViewModel:** - Created `RssSourceRepository` to load RSS sources from the JSON asset file. - Implemented `AddSourcesViewModel` to manage the UI state and logic for loading and adding RSS sources. It interacts with `RssSourceRepository`, `AddedRssSourceDao`, `RssSv`, and `AccountSv`. - **UI:** - Added new composable screens: - `AddSourcesPage`: Displays a list of countries to choose RSS sources from. - `AddSourceDetailPage`: Displays a list of RSS sources for a selected country, allowing users to add them. It shows loading states, error messages, and confirmation dialogs. - Integrated these new screens into the navigation graph in `HomeEntry.kt`. - Added new route names `ADD_SOURCES` and `ADD_SOURCES_DETAIL` in `RouteName.kt`. - **DI:** - Provided `AddedRssSourceDao` in `DbModule.kt`. - Provided `Gson` in `RetrofitModule.kt` for JSON parsing in `RssSourceRepository`. - **Filtering:** - Added a new `Filter.AddSources` type in `Filter.kt` to represent the "Add Sources" page. - Updated `FeedsPage.kt` to navigate to `RouteName.ADD_SOURCES` when the "Add Sources" filter is selected.

Refactor AddSourceDetailPage with animations and UI improvements
This commit refactors the `AddSourceDetailPage` to enhance user experience with animations and UI adjustments.
- Introduced animations for item appearance, disappearance, and content size changes in the `LazyColumn` displaying RSS sources. - Added a `RssSourceItemState` data class to manage the state of each RSS source item, facilitating animation and diffing. - The loading indicator during source addition is now animated with slide and fade transitions. - Source items now have animated alpha and elevation based on their "added" state. - The `LazyColumn` now maintains the original order of sources instead of sorting them. - Updated the text in the loading indicator from "Adding RSS source..." to "Adding RSS feed...". - Minor styling adjustments to card elevation, border, and progress indicator size.

Refactor AddSourceDetailPage with animations and UI improvements
This commit refactors the `AddSourceDetailPage` to enhance user experience with animations and UI adjustments.
- Introduced animations for item appearance, disappearance, and content size changes in the `LazyColumn` displaying RSS sources. - Added a `RssSourceItemState` data class to manage the state of each RSS source item, facilitating animation and diffing. - The loading indicator during source addition is now animated with slide and fade transitions. - Source items now have animated alpha and elevation based on their "added" state. - The `LazyColumn` now maintains the original order of sources instead of sorting them. - Updated the text in the loading indicator from "Adding RSS source..." to "Adding RSS feed...". - Minor styling adjustments to card elevation, border, and progress indicator size.

Remove LoadingContent from AddSourceDetailPage
This commit removes the `LoadingContent` composable from `AddSourceDetailPage.kt`. The loading state is no longer explicitly handled within the `when` block in the main composable.

Refactor AddSourceDetailPage UI and UX
This commit refactors the `AddSourceDetailPage` to improve the user interface and experience when adding RSS sources.
- Removed various `androidx.compose.animation` imports as they are no longer used. - The `RssSourceItemState` data class now includes an `isLoading` boolean to track the loading state of individual RSS source additions, replacing the previous `animationKey`. - A global `loadingSourceUrl` state is introduced in `AddSourceDetailPage` to manage the loading indicator for the source currently being added. - A general loading indicator (`CircularProgressIndicator`) is now displayed when the initial list of RSS sources is being fetched. - The `SourcesList` composable now takes a `loadingSourceUrl` parameter instead of `isAddingSource`. - The `RssSourceItemState` in `SourcesList` now correctly determines `isLoading` and `isEnabled` based on `loadingSourceUrl` and whether the source is already added. - Removed the animated loading indicator card that was previously shown at the top of the `SourcesList` when a source was being added. - Removed `AnimatedVisibility` and `animateContentSize` from the `items` within `SourcesList`, simplifying the item rendering. - The `SourceItem` composable now includes an `isLoading` parameter. - Removed elevation animation and border from `SourceItem` Card. - The `SourceItem` Card's container color is now consistently `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface`. - The text color in `SourceItem` is now consistently `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface` or a derivative for icons and secondary text. - The add/check icon section in `SourceItem` now displays a `CircularProgressIndicator` when `isLoading` is true for that specific item. The background and icon tint change based on the `isAdded`, `isLoading`, and `enabled` states.

Refactor AddSourceDetailPage UI and logic
This commit refactors the `AddSourceDetailPage` to improve the user experience when adding sources.
- The "Add" button for a source is now disabled if any other source is currently being loaded. This prevents multiple sources from being added simultaneously. - The color of the "Add" icon is now grayed out when the button is disabled to visually indicate its state. - The click listener for adding a source now only triggers if no other source is currently loading.

Refactor AddSourceDetailPage and ViewModel
This commit refactors `AddSourceDetailPage.kt` and `AddSourcesViewModel.kt`.
- In `AddSourceDetailPage.kt`: - Removed the explicit reloading of sources after adding an RSS feed, as the UI now updates automatically via `StateFlow`. - Simplified the `LazyListState` creation in `SourceList`. - Removed the "Available RSS Sources" title from the list. - Added bottom padding of 12.dp to `SourceItem`. - In `AddSourcesViewModel.kt`: - The UI state (`_uiState`) is now updated directly after successfully adding an RSS source, ensuring the UI reflects the change immediately.

Adjust padding in AddSourceDetailPage
This commit modifies the bottom padding of the `LazyColumn` in `AddSourceDetailPage.kt` from 16.dp to 0.dp.

Refactor AddSourcesPage and navigation
This commit refactors the `AddSourcesPage.kt` and related navigation logic.
- Renamed `AddSourcesPage` composable to `AddSourcesMainPage` in `app/src/main/java/com/mckimquyen/reader/ui/page/home/addsources/AddSourcesPage.kt`. - Updated the route in `HomeEntry.kt` to use `AddSourcesMainPage` for the `RouteName.ADD_SOURCES` destination. - In `FlowPage.kt` and `FeedsPage.kt`, when the "AddSources" tab is tapped, the app now navigates to the `RouteName.ADD_SOURCES` route, ensuring `launchSingleTop = true`. This prevents multiple instances of the `AddSourcesMainPage` from being created.

Refactor AddSources tab in FlowPage and FeedsPage
This commit refactors the "Add Sources" tab behavior in `FlowPage` and `FeedsPage`.
- Instead of navigating to a separate `CountriesList` screen, the `CountriesList` composable is now displayed directly within the `FlowPage` and `FeedsPage` when the "Add Sources" filter is selected. - The navigation logic for the "Add Sources" tab in the bottom filter bar has been removed from both `FlowPage` and `FeedsPage`. The UI now updates based on the filter state change. - In `FlowPage`, `fetchArticles()` is now only called if the selected filter is not "Add Sources".

Refactor AddSources tab in FlowPage and FeedsPage
This commit refactors the "Add Sources" tab behavior in `FlowPage` and `FeedsPage`.
- Instead of navigating to a separate `CountriesList` screen, the `CountriesList` composable is now displayed directly within the `FlowPage` and `FeedsPage` when the "Add Sources" filter is selected. - The navigation logic for the "Add Sources" tab in the bottom filter bar has been removed from both `FlowPage` and `FeedsPage`. The UI now updates based on the filter state change. - In `FlowPage`, `fetchArticles()` is now only called if the selected filter is not "Add Sources".

Refactor CountryCard UI in AddSourcesPage
This commit refactors the `CountryCard` composable in `AddSourcesPage.kt`.
- The overall layout and styling of `CountryCard` are updated to be more consistent with RSS item cards. - The country flag is now displayed in a `Box` with a background color and rounded corners. - The country name and "Explore RSS sources" text are now arranged in a `Column` next to the flag, with updated typography and spacing. - A language icon is added next to the "Explore RSS sources" text. - The navigation chevron icon is now placed in a circular `Box` with a background color. - Padding is added to the `LazyColumn` containing the `CountryCard` items. - The `containerColor` of the `Card` is changed from `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.4f)` to `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface`. - The `contentColor` of the `Card` is set to `MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface`. - Spacers between `CountryCard` items in the `LazyColumn` have been removed, and bottom padding is added to each `CountryCard` instead.

Update and expand RSS sources
This commit significantly updates and expands the list of RSS sources in `rss_sources.json` for both English and Vietnamese languages.
- **English (en):** - "Global News" is moved to a later position in the list. - Numerous new sources are added across various categories including: - News: Associated Press, NPR News, The Guardian - World, Al Jazeera English, Washington Post, New York Times - World - Technology: Wired, Engadget, Gizmodo, MIT Technology Review, IEEE Spectrum, 9to5Mac, MacRumors, Android Authority, XDA Developers - Business: Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Financial Times, Forbes, Harvard Business Review, Entrepreneur - Sports: ESPN, Sky Sports, BBC Sport, NFL News, NBA - Science: Scientific American, Nature, Science Magazine, National Geographic, NASA News, Space.com - Entertainment: Variety, Entertainment Weekly, The Hollywood Reporter, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork - Gaming: IGN, GameSpot, Polygon, PC Gamer - General/Other: Medium - Top Stories, Reddit - r/worldnews, Reddit - r/technology, Product Hunt, Dev.to, Smashing Magazine, A List Apart, CSS-Tricks
- **Vietnamese (vi):** - Many new sources and specific category feeds from existing sources are added, including: - VnExpress: Thế giới, Kinh doanh, Công nghệ, Thể thao - Dân Trí: Thế giới, Công nghệ - Thanh Niên: Thế giới, Game - VietnamNet: Công nghệ, Kinh doanh - Zing News: Công nghệ, Kinh doanh - Tuổi Trẻ: Thế giới, Công nghệ - 24h: Công nghệ - Vietnamplus: Thế giới - New sources: Báo Mới, VOV - Đài tiếng nói Việt Nam, Báo Người Lao Động, Tiền Phong, Lao Động, Cafef (Kinh tế, Chứng khoán), Tập chí Doanh nhân Sài Gòn, ICTNews - Công nghệ, VnReview - Công nghệ, Genk.vn - Công nghệ, Tinhte.vn, Thể Thao 247, Saostar - Giải trí, Ví Dân - Tài chính, Eva.vn - Phụ nữ, Kenh14 - Giải trí, GameLandVN - Game, Hà Nội Mới, Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, Báo Đầu tư, VTC News, Vietnam.net, Báo Đất Việt

Refactor data loading to be asynchronous
This commit refactors data loading in `HomeEntry.kt`, `MainActivity.kt`, and `AccountSettings.kt` to be asynchronous. This is done to prevent Application Not Responding (ANR) errors by moving data loading off the main thread.
- In `HomeEntry.kt`, `initialPage` and `initialFilter` are now loaded asynchronously from DataStore using `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)`. - In `MainActivity.kt`, language preferences are loaded asynchronously from DataStore, and AdMob initialization is also moved to a background thread. - In `AccountSettings.kt`, `currentAccountId` is loaded asynchronously from DataStore. Account settings are then loaded based on this ID, using defaults until the actual settings are available.

Add unit tests and update dependencies
This commit introduces unit tests for various components and updates some dependencies.
- Added `FilterTest.kt` to test the `RssSource` and `RssSourcesData` models. - Added `RssSourcesTest.kt` to test parsing of RSS source JSON data. - Added `DataStoreExtensionsTest.kt` to test `DataStoreKeys`. - Added `StringExtensionsTest.kt` to test string utility functions. - Updated `app/build.gradle` to include test dependencies: - `junit:junit:4.13.2` - `io.mockk:mockk:1.13.5` - `org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-test:1.6.4` - Commented-out test dependencies were re-enabled and `leakcanary` was moved to be with other debug implementations.

Refactor threading and add basic unit tests
This commit refactors threading in `CrashHandler`, `AccountSv`, and `MainActivity` to prevent ANRs and ensure UI operations run on the main thread. - In `CrashHandler`, toasts are now shown on the main thread using `Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post`. - In `AccountSv`, the toast for "must_have_an_account" is now shown on the main thread using `withContext(Dispatchers.Main)`. - In `MainActivity`, AdMob initialization is moved to the main thread using `lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.Main)`.
Additionally, this commit: - Deletes `DataStoreExtensionsTest.kt`, `FilterTest.kt`, `RssSourcesTest.kt`, and `StringExtensionsTest.kt`. - Adds a new `BasicUnitTest.java` file with basic unit tests covering string operations, URL validation, RSS source validation, application constants, RSS sources expansion, preference validation, RSS categories, DataStore keys, version information, and ANR fix validation.

Update ProGuard rules and Gradle configuration
This commit updates the ProGuard rules for Rome library and adds configurations to Gradle for KAPT and JVM arguments.
- In `app/proguard-rules.pro`: - Changed keep rules for Rome library classes (`com.rometools.rome.feed.**`, `com.rometools.rome.io.**`, `com.rometools.modules.**`) to not allow shrinking or obfuscation. - Added keep rules for Rome RSS parser plugins (`com.rometools.rome.feed.synd.impl.**`, `com.rometools.rome.feed.atom.**`, `com.rometools.rome.feed.rss.**`) to prevent `ClassNotFoundException`. - Added keep rules for ServiceLoader implementations to ensure `newInstance()` and implementations of `Converter`, `ModuleParser`, and `ModuleGenerator` are preserved. - In `app/build.gradle`: - Added a configuration to set `jvmTarget = "17"` for `KaptGenerateStubsTask` to fix KAPT compatibility with newer Java versions. - In `gradle.properties`: - Added `kapt.include.compile.classpath=false`. - Expanded `org.gradle.jvmargs` and `kotlin.daemon.jvmargs` with additional `--add-exports` and `--add-opens` for `jdk.compiler` to ensure compatibility with newer JDK versions. - Added `.idea/appInsightsSettings.xml` to configure Firebase Crashlytics integration. - Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` with layout configurations and minor changes.

Update ProGuard rules and Gradle configuration
This commit updates the ProGuard rules for Rome library and adds configurations to Gradle for KAPT and JVM arguments.
- In `app/proguard-rules.pro`: - Changed keep rules for Rome library classes (`com.rometools.rome.feed.**`, `com.rometools.rome.io.**`, `com.rometools.modules.**`) to not allow shrinking or obfuscation. - Added keep rules for Rome RSS parser plugins (`com.rometools.rome.feed.synd.impl.**`, `com.rometools.rome.feed.atom.**`, `com.rometools.rome.feed.rss.**`) to prevent `ClassNotFoundException`. - Added keep rules for ServiceLoader implementations to ensure `newInstance()` and implementations of `Converter`, `ModuleParser`, and `ModuleGenerator` are preserved. - In `app/build.gradle`: - Added a configuration to set `jvmTarget = "17"` for `KaptGenerateStubsTask` to fix KAPT compatibility with newer Java versions. - In `gradle.properties`: - Added `kapt.include.compile.classpath=false`. - Expanded `org.gradle.jvmargs` and `kotlin.daemon.jvmargs` with additional `--add-exports` and `--add-opens` for `jdk.compiler` to ensure compatibility with newer JDK versions. - Added `.idea/appInsightsSettings.xml` to configure Firebase Crashlytics integration. - Updated `.idea/workspace.xml` with layout configurations and minor changes.

Configure release signing from `keystore.properties`
This commit refactors the release signing process to load credentials from a `keystore.properties` file instead of hardcoding them in `app/build.gradle`. This enhances security by allowing developers to keep sensitive keystore information out of version control.

- **Localization (`strings.xml`)**: - Added translations for the new language source names (e.g., "Japanese Sources", "French Sources") and other UI elements related to adding sources. - New translations provided for: `ar`, `de-rDE`, `es-rES`, `fr-rFR`, `in-rID`, `it-rIT`, `ja`, `pl-rPL`, `pt-rBR`, `pt`, `ru-rRU`, `vi`, `zh-rCN`, and `zh-rTW`. - Added placeholder English strings for languages pending translation (e.g., `az`, `bg`, `ca`, `cs-rCZ`, `da`, `eu-rES`, `fa`, `hi-rIN`, `hu`, `iw`, `kn`, `lzh`, `ml`, `my`, `nb-rNO`, `nl`, `nn`, `ro`, `sl`, `sr`, `sv`, `tr`, `uk`).
- **Code Changes**: - **`RssSource.kt`**: Updated the `RssSourcesData` data class to include fields for all the new language codes. - **`RssSourceRepository.kt`**: Extended the `when` statement to handle the new language codes and load the corresponding sources from the JSON file. - **`AddSourcesPage.kt`**: - Expanded the `CountriesList` to display all the new languages with their respective flags and names. - Used `stringResource` for translatable text. - **`AddSourceDetailPage.kt`**: - Updated to display the correct country name and flag based on the new language codes. - Replaced hardcoded strings with `stringResource` calls for better internationalization of UI elements like snackbar messages, dialogs, and empty/error states.

Feat: Implement in-app language switching with app restart
This commit introduces a robust in-app language switching feature. When a user selects a new language, the app now prompts for confirmation and then gracefully restarts to apply the change system-wide.
- **`LanguagesPage.kt`**: - Replaced the immediate language change with a confirmation dialog (`AlertDialog`) that informs the user the app will restart. - Upon confirmation, the selected language preference is saved to DataStore. - A loading dialog is shown while the app prepares to restart. - Utilizes the `ProcessPhoenix` library to trigger a clean application rebirth, ensuring the new language is applied correctly.
- **`RApp.kt` & `MainActivity.kt`**: - The logic for setting the app's locale has been moved to `attachBaseContext` in both the `Application` and `MainActivity`. - This ensures the language preference is read from DataStore and applied very early in the application lifecycle, preventing UI inconsistencies and ANRs related to asynchronous language loading in `MainActivity`.
- **`LanguagesPref.kt`**: - Expanded the `LanguagesPref` enum to include 26 new languages (Japanese, Portuguese, Arabic, Turkish, Dutch, etc.). - Removed the now-redundant `setLocale` function, as this logic is centralized in `attachBaseContext`.
- **Dependencies (`app/build.gradle`)**: - Added the `com.jakewharton:process-phoenix:3.0.0` dependency to handle application restarts.
- **Localization (`strings.xml`)**: - Added new string resources for the language change confirmation dialog and restarting message (e.g., `change_language`, `change_language_confirm`, `restarting_app`) across all supported languages. - Added translated names for the newly supported languages.

This commit updates the application versioning and introduces a development guidelines document. It also includes standard IDE configuration updates.

- **`doc/init.md` & `app/doc/init.md`**: - Created a new documentation file outlining high-priority coding standards, including: - Requirement to use `AppSnackbar` instead of `Get.snack`. - Mandatory use of `GetX` for state management instead of `setState` or `late` variables. - Enforcement of currency formatting for amount-related text inputs. - Requirements for consistent animations and memory leak prevention.
- **`.idea/`**: - Updated `modules.xml` to include the project module. - Updated `workspace.xml` with recent task history and IDE state changes.

Refactor: Fix memory leaks and update project documentation
This commit addresses critical memory leaks related to `Activity` references and improves project documentation. It also includes several IDE configuration updates.
- **`AdMobManager.kt`**: - Fixed a major memory leak in `initSplashScreen` where a `CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Default)` was collecting a `SharedFlow` indefinitely while holding a reference to the `Activity`. - Refactored the logic to use the `Activity`'s `lifecycleScope` and `first()` to ensure the coroutine completes and the reference is released. - Updated `EventBus` to use a `MutableSharedFlow` with `replay = 1` for more reliable event delivery during initialization.
- **`MainActivity.kt`**: - Added an `onDestroy` override to nullify the `AdMobManager.interstitialListener`. This prevents the Singleton `AdMobManager` from holding a strong reference to a destroyed `MainActivity`.
- **Documentation**: - Renamed `app/doc/init.md` to `doc/memory_leak.md` and significantly expanded it. - Added a detailed report on potential and fixed memory leaks, covering `SharedFlow` collectors, Singleton listeners, and `Handler.postDelayed` usage. - Included a summary of the project's architectural health and tech stack (Jetpack Compose, GetX, Hilt).
- **IDE Configuration (`.idea/`)**: - Added `markdown.xml` to configure the markdown preview provider. - Updated `deviceStreaming.xml` with an extensive list of persistent device selection data for various Samsung, Google, and Motorola devices. - Removed the redundant `modules.xml`. - Updated `workspace.xml` with recent changes, task history, and component state.
